On **March 23, 2026**, LocalStack changed its distribution model: all images now require a `LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN`, ending the frictionless free-tier experience that made LocalStack a de facto standard.

Teams choosing between paying for LocalStack Pro and migrating to open-source alternatives have two serious general-purpose candidates: **Floci** (`floci-io/floci`) and **MiniStack** (`ministackorg/ministack`).
Both run on port 4566, require no auth token, and target LocalStack-style drop-in use.
Neither is a safe bet if adopted blindly — both are under 90 days old as of this writing, and each carries specific fidelity risks that must be validated against your actual workloads.

**Moto, ElasticMQ, and MinIO remain useful but specialized tools, not LocalStack replacements.** The recommendation is to validate your 3–5 most critical workflows against whichever finalist fits your profile before committing.
